content: Hui-chieh:

raw: If memory serves me correctly, and I don't trust it to, the old man's name was Ivan Iziaslav.
content: If memory serves me correctly, and I don't trust it to, the old man's name was Ivan Iziaslav.

raw: A very common name. And he was the sort of peasant farmer you could find anywhere.
content: A very common name. And he was the sort of peasant farmer you could find anywhere.

raw: But he sacrificed himself. For a whole mess of reasons, he gave his own life...
content: But he sacrificed himself. For a whole mess of reasons, he gave his own life...

raw: I think about it every now and then. Am I truly worth people sacrificing their lives?
content: I think about it every now and then. Am I truly worth people sacrificing their lives?

raw: Alina went with me. She was gentle most other times, but would suddenly just come out with venomous tongue-lashings. That made me uncomfortable, to say the least.
content: Alina went with me. She was gentle most other times, but would suddenly just come out with venomous tongue-lashings. That made me uncomfortable, to say the least.
The plan was proceeding smoothly.

raw: In accordance with my own ideas, rapidly, the Infected of this place would surely unite as one.
content: In accordance with my own ideas, rapidly, the Infected of this place would surely unite as one.

raw: I hoped it would be effective.
content: I hoped it would be effective.

raw: And I hoped it would be enough for the old man to rest peacefully. Aside from the old lady, no-one else had been closer family to me.
content: And I hoped it would be enough for the old man to rest peacefully. Aside from the old lady, no-one else had been closer family to me.
February 7th

raw: Third year without the Black Snake
content: Third year without the Black Snake

speaker: Talulah
content: Sir, I'm...

raw: [name="Infected"] Whatcha here for? Don't like the look of your clothes. Some old vet, are you?
speaker: Infected
content: Whatcha here for? Don't like the look of your clothes. Some old vet, are you?

raw: [name="Infected"] Get lost! There's nothing even left here. You lot stole it, all of it! And what you couldn't steal, you burned!
speaker: Infected
content: Get lost! There's nothing even left here. You lot stole it, all of it! And what you couldn't steal, you burned!

raw: [name="Infected"] Bastards! You came to kill me? Kill me, then! Goddamned demons!
speaker: Infected
content: Bastards! You came to kill me? Kill me, then! Goddamned demons!

raw: [name="Talulah"] No, sir, I'm here to tell you that the Infected Patrol Unit is sweeping this area today.
speaker: Talulah
content: No, sir, I'm here to tell you that the Infected Patrol Unit is sweeping this area today.

raw: [name="Infected"] Then let 'em sweep! Let 'em kill us all, why don't you!
speaker: Infected
content: Then let 'em sweep! Let 'em kill us all, why don't you!

raw: [name="Infected"] We built our pathetic, unlivable village all the way out here, and they still come for us! What else can we do but let 'em!?
speaker: Infected
content: We built our pathetic, unlivable village all the way out here, and they still come for us! What else can we do but let 'em!?

raw: [name="Talulah"] Sir. You can hide yourselves, and I'll talk to them. Or I can conceal myself...
speaker: Talulah
content: Sir. You can hide yourselves, and I'll talk to them. Or I can conceal myself...

raw: [name="Infected"] And who're you? I always said, you military noble bunch, no matter what you pretend! You're all just out for our lives—
speaker: Infected
content: And who're you? I always said, you military noble bunch, no matter what you pretend! You're all just out for our lives—

raw: [name="Infected"] Hah, you're not quite their sort. You actually talk with us! And they think we're barely even worth whipping!
speaker: Infected
content: Hah, you're not quite their sort. You actually talk with us! And they think we're barely even worth whipping!

speaker: Infected
content: Huh? Hello?

speaker: Infected
content: Gone...?

raw: [name="Infected"] What kind of stunt is this? Oh... damn us all...
speaker: Infected
content: What kind of stunt is this? Oh... damn us all...

raw: [name="Infected"] Damn us all. What a pathetic ending.
speaker: Infected
content: Damn us all. What a pathetic ending.

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  It's no bad thing to know your own damnation.
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: It's no bad thing to know your own damnation.

speaker: Infected
content: Ah... Mr. Patrolman...

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  ...Destitute and lousy. Bad physique. You wouldn't be much use even if we sent you to the mines.
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: ...Destitute and lousy. Bad physique. You wouldn't be much use even if we sent you to the mines.

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  How do you want to die, then? Painlessly? Slowly?
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: How do you want to die, then? Painlessly? Slowly?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=0, ystrength=20, vibrato=20, randomness=20, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Infected"] ...Mr. Patrolman! Look at me... what harm would leaving me alive do you?
speaker: Infected
content: ...Mr. Patrolman! Look at me... what harm would leaving me alive do you?

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  You say that with a weapon in your hand?
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: You say that with a weapon in your hand?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=0, ystrength=20, vibrato=20, randomness=20, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Infected"] ...Sorry, Mr. Patrolman! This was for whoever that was just a minute ago! I don't know where she's gone now, but...
speaker: Infected
content: ...Sorry, Mr. Patrolman! This was for whoever that was just a minute ago! I don't know where she's gone now, but...

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  Even burdenbeasts are worth more than you Infected. They can at least move goods. Your existence is a waste of His Majesty's land!
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: Even burdenbeasts are worth more than you Infected. They can at least move goods. Your existence is a waste of His Majesty's land!

speaker: Talulah
content: Why is that?

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  Where did you come from?
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: Where did you come from?

speaker: Talulah
content: From far, far east.

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  What the hell are you...? You, are you Infected too?
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: What the hell are you...? You, are you Infected too?

speaker: Talulah
content: I am.

raw: [name="Talulah"] I can think. I can speak.
speaker: Talulah
content: I can think. I can speak.

raw: [name="Talulah"] We Infected live and die. Why should you decide when and how?
speaker: Talulah
content: We Infected live and die. Why should you decide when and how?

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  What is this bullshit?!
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: What is this bullshit?!

raw: [name="Talulah"] If you could let us die peacefully on our own terms, we'd hardly even be upset about it...
speaker: Talulah
content: If you could let us die peacefully on our own terms, we'd hardly even be upset about it...

raw: [name="Talulah"] But, my Infected brother, look up at him! Look at his face, his grin, his laugh!
speaker: Talulah
content: But, my Infected brother, look up at him! Look at his face, his grin, his laugh!

raw: [name="Talulah"] They want to decide our fates. Control us. Perhaps our lives aren't worth much, but do you think you'd be worth a single gold coin?
speaker: Talulah
content: They want to decide our fates. Control us. Perhaps our lives aren't worth much, but do you think you'd be worth a single gold coin?

speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: You!

raw: [name="Talulah"] My brother, in all their past outrageous acts, have they ever spared someone for their conduct? Have they ever let another live for following instructions?
speaker: Talulah
content: My brother, in all their past outrageous acts, have they ever spared someone for their conduct? Have they ever let another live for following instructions?

raw: [name="Talulah"] They have not! Each time they let you live, it was only because they still saw worth they could squeeze from you!
speaker: Talulah
content: They have not! Each time they let you live, it was only because they still saw worth they could squeeze from you!

raw: [name="Talulah"] With no money and no land left, they'd kick you to the floor. After all, the cities don't even give Infected the chance to live!
speaker: Talulah
content: With no money and no land left, they'd kick you to the floor. After all, the cities don't even give Infected the chance to live!

raw: [name="Talulah"] How should we Infected live? How should we die? That is for us to decide!
speaker: Talulah
content: How should we Infected live? How should we die? That is for us to decide!

speaker: Infected
content: But... who are you?

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  You good-for-nothing! Tell me your name at once!
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: You good-for-nothing! Tell me your name at once!

raw: [name="Infected Patrol Unit"]  In the name of the Emperor! For daring to lead his citizenry astray with these ludicrous ideals, we sentence you to death!
speaker: Infected Patrol Unit
content: In the name of the Emperor! For daring to lead his citizenry astray with these ludicrous ideals, we sentence you to death!

raw: [name="Talulah"] To my brothers, I have no name. Refer to me how you wish. If you must call me something, you may call me Talulah.
speaker: Talulah
content: To my brothers, I have no name. Refer to me how you wish. If you must call me something, you may call me Talulah.

raw: [name="Talulah"] To my enemies, you have no need for my name.
speaker: Talulah
content: To my enemies, you have no need for my name.

raw: [name="Talulah"] But my fires will set you alight.
speaker: Talulah
content: But my fires will set you alight.
